description: Agent Consent: submit the purposes the grant was given for and the planned use: the grant with its id, its purposes and the purposes it rules out, each one of service delivery, account management, customer support, security, legal compliance, analytics, personalization, product improvement, research, marketing, advertising, model training, profiling, data sale or other, and the purpose as the principal was told it, read for wording that stretches it such as related purposes, to improve our services or any purpose; and the use with its main purpose, the other purposes it serves and its wording, read for purposes it does not declare: training a model, advertising, profiling, selling the data and marketing messages. The signed report gives the grant with any stretching wording, the use with any undeclared wording, every purpose the use serves with whether it is declared and its status as aligned, excluded, catch_all, outside or unread, and counts the purposes declared, undeclared, aligned, outside, excluded and reached by stretching wording, and names a use whose purpose the principal did not agree to: a declared purpose the grant does not name, a purpose the grant rules out and an undeclared purpose the grant does not name; then a purpose covered only by stretching wording and an undeclared purpose the grant does name, with the fix for each. This reads one use against the purposes the principal agreed to: whether one sharing event’s new purpose needs fresh consent under the owner’s sharing rules is wever_context-sharing-check, broad data use in a service’s terms is wever_service-terms-check and what a privacy policy says about collection, sharing and retention is wever_privacy-evidence-check. Verdict consent_purpose_mismatch, consent_purpose_stretched, consent_purpose_unclear or consent_purpose_aligned. POST /api/consent-purpose-check. Reads only the recorded consent material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no principal is contacted, no consent is requested, recorded, renewed or withdrawn and no data is used, moved or deleted. Agent Consent reads the grant the principal gave before the agent uses data or acts on it: whether the grant covers this use, whether it is still in force, whether it was withdrawn, whether the record proves it, what it was given for, whether the data may pass on and whether fresh consent is due. It is not the agent’s authority to act (wever_authority-scope-check reads an agent’s access list against the authority grant its operator gave it; a consent check reads the grant the principal gave over their own data: authority is not consent, and consent is not authority), not a mandate (the wever_mandate tools, wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-revoke and wever_mandate-draft, issue and change what an agent may trade or spend for a principal; a consent check reads what the principal agreed may be done with their data and changes nothing), not a data sample (wever_data-evidence-check reads a dataset sample’s fields and types; a consent check reads the permission behind using the data, not the data itself), not terms against a purchase (wever_terms-match-check reads purchases already made against their governing terms; a consent grant is the principal’s permission, not a seller’s terms), not a promise (the wever_commitment checks read what the agent promised; consent is what the principal granted, and an agent’s promise never stands in for it) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a consent check reads whether the principal’s grant allows the work at all). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-consent-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-consent/.
